description:
Reissue a lost evaluate_token by proving ownership of the buyer wallet.

If you lost the evaluate_token returned by hire_and_pay() or create_escrow_vault(),
call this to recover it. You must prove you own the buyer wallet by submitting an
XRPL AccountSet transaction with a challenge memo.

escrow_id.description: The escrow vault ID whose evaluate_token was lost.
escrow_id.title: Escrow ID

tx_hash.description: Hash of an XRPL AccountSet tx you submitted from wallet_address with a Memo containing the challenge string from get_wallet_verification_challenge(). This proves you own the buyer wallet.
tx_hash.title: Verification Transaction Hash

wallet_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) — must match the buyer address on the vault.
wallet_address.title: Buyer Wallet Address

name: reissue_evaluate_token
title: Reissue Evaluate Token
